title: Immensity
summary: IMMENS'ITY, noun Unlimited extension; an extent not to be measured; infinity. By the power we find in ourselves of repeating, as often as we will, any idea of space, we get the idea of immensity 1. Va

inlines.v: IMMENS'ITY, noun Unlimited extension; an extent not to be measured; infinity. By the power we find in ourselves of repeating, as often as we will, any idea of space, we get the idea of immensity 1. Vastness in extent or bulk; greatness.
